verdict.rationale: Lighthouse publishes free blog guides on founder-relevant visas (an EB-1A guide covering premium processing and RFE/NOID strategy, an E-2 treaty-countries post, a sponsorship-cost comparison, an H-4 guide), plus a public customers page with founder case stories. The evidence does not show dedicated startup-visa criteria breakdowns, and the guides sit next to eligibility quizzes and service pitches, so it is unproven that they are substantial rather than lead funnels. Missing for 10: explicit startup/founder-visa criteria breakdowns, evidence the content is fully ungated, depth of the real examples, independent corroboration of guide quality.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider publishes substantial free guides on startup visas — criteria breakdowns, process explainers, real examples — open to anyone, not gated lead bait
